texts.welcome: We are so excited to celebrate our love with the people who mean the most to us. Join us for a day filled with laughter, love, and happily ever afters.
texts.story:
It started with a chance encounter at a coffee shop, where Isabel ordered a tea and Kevin spilled his coffee. Nervous laughter turned into a conversation that lasted for hours, and we haven't stopped talking since.

Through travels, late-night study sessions, and building a home together, our bond only grew stronger. We realized that we weren't just partners; we were best friends ready to take on the world together.

Three years later, under a canopy of autumn leaves, Kevin got down on one knee. With tears of joy and a resounding "Yes!", we began this beautiful journey toward our wedding day.
